rationale: The prose uses accessible vocabulary and a light, whimsical comic tone built on children's antics (a 'committee' holding an ear hostage, a wooden-spoon talking stick, a shouted 'Pineapple!' code word), with no graphic violence or mature content, while the wry first-person voice, in-jokes about military and council procedure, and callbacks to earlier events imply an established fantasy series and a teen-to-adult crossover readership.
